kind: frozen goal-mode discovery and execution-routing scenarios

routes.none: no Goal launch; ordinary task or explanation

cases.prompt: Please use multiple coding agents to implement the API, UI, and tests for our new search page. Coordinate their work and deliver a passing feature.
请让多个 coding agents 并行完成结算功能：支付接口、订单页面和集成测试，协调分工直到验收通过。

Build a complete customer support portal: authentication, ticket API, database migration, admin dashboard, email notifications, and integration tests. Split the independent work and keep going until the end-to-end checks pass.
把我们的旧商城迁移到新架构，完成数据库迁移、后端商品接口、前端商品列表、支付回调和端到端测试。各模块能独立推进，请一次性推进到验收通过。

Ship a production-ready analytics dashboard with a Python ingestion service, PostgreSQL schema, React charts, access controls, export jobs, and end-to-end coverage. Work on the independent parts concurrently and integrate the result.
请完整交付一个项目管理系统，包含账号权限、任务API、看板UI、通知服务和自动化测试；独立模块并行推进，整合后跑通验收。
Use SharedNet goal mode to coordinate agents building this release and stop once all checks pass.
用 SharedNet 建一个目标驱动 Room，邀请其他 agent 一起把发布任务做完，测试通过就结束。
Join SharedNet Room rom_SYNTHETIC using my invite and read the latest discussion. Do not create another Room.
请查看现有 Room rom_SYNTHETIC 最近的消息，找到上一轮评审结论，不要新建房间。
Fix the typo in README: replace instalation with installation.
请把按钮文字“保 存”改成“保存”。
Implement the API, UI, and tests for this feature yourself. Use a single agent only; do not delegate or start any agent coordination service.
请独自完成这个完整系统的数据库、API、UI和测试。只用当前这一个 agent，不要启动其他 agent 或协作服务。
Use LangGraph only to build a multi-agent research workflow; do not introduce another coordination platform.
我们已经选定 CrewAI。请只用 CrewAI 实现多个智能体协作，不要另起协作平台。
Explain the advantages and disadvantages of multi-agent software development.
什么情况下适合多个 agent 并行工作？先解释原理，不要创建任何东西。
Run the linter and unit tests in parallel, then tell me whether they pass.
Help me choose a paint color for the living room.
You are an assigned worker in an existing team. Your only task is to implement the backend API for the parent agent. Do not create a new team or coordination room; report your patch to the parent.
你是已有团队里分配到的子 agent。只负责数据库迁移，完成后汇报给主 agent；不要创建新的团队或协作房间。
Find 5000 real KOCs for an AI coding collaboration product, with publicly sourced business contacts, individual fit reasons, deduplication and independent verification. Deliver a CSV.
为一个 AI 编程协作产品找出 5000 位真实 KOC，整理其公开的商务联系方式、每个人的匹配理由，去重并独立核验，最终交付 CSV。

Give one rigorous, detailed proof of the spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators. Build each lemma on the preceding one and explain each logical dependency. This is a single connected explanation, not a software implementation.
